name: recorded_member_count_star_many_to_one
question: 普通、银卡、金卡和白金用户，各自最喜欢哪三类电影？按实际购票人数来看，同时看看订单量和扣掉退款后的收入，全额退款的订单不算。

candidates.sql: WITH "ranked_by_level" AS (SELECT "c".membership_level, "m".genre, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customer_id) AS purchasing_customers, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM("t".total_amount - "t".refund_amount) AS net_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".membership_level ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customer_id) DESC, "m".genre ASC) AS rn FROM ticket_orders AS "t" JOIN customers AS "c" ON "t".customer_id = "c".customer_id JOIN screenings AS "s" ON "t".screening_id = "s".screening_id JOIN movies AS "m" ON "s".movie_id = "m".movie_id WHERE "c".membership_level IN ('normal', 'silver', 'gold', 'platinum') AND "t".order_status <> 'refunded' GROUP BY "c".membership_level, "m".genre) SELECT membership_level, genre, purchasing_customers, order_count, net_revenue FROM "ranked_by_level" WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY membership_level, rn LIMIT 200
